# Senior Front End Engineer (React)

## Summary
We are looking for experienced engineers to contribute significantly towards the development of complex user interfaces within our platform solutions. The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of modern web technologies like JavaScript/TypeScript and is eager to work on high-quality backend services alongside client teams. This role requires strong technical leadership while collaborating closely with product owners and business stakeholders.

## Required Skills
- Expert proficiency in ReactJS framework
- Strong understanding of Typescript programming language
- Experience working with state management libraries such as Redux or MobX
- Familiarity with serverless frameworks including AWS Lambda and Cloud Functions
- Knowledge of microservices architecture concepts
- Ability to design robust data structures using type systems
- Proficiency in developing reusable code modules from scratch
- Understanding of architectural patterns used by large enterprise platforms

## Responsibilities
- Lead projects involving advanced software engineering skills at an upper level
- Collaborate extensively with project managers, developers, designers, and clients across various stages
- Design, develop, test, deploy, monitor, maintain, optimize, and enhance core application features
- Contribute actively during all phases of requirements gathering through final delivery planning sessions
- Ensure timely completion of tasks according to defined timelines and deliverables set forth by SREs
- Participate directly in defining system architectures based upon specific customer needs
- Serve as part of cross-functional team environments where direct communication between leads occurs frequently
- Actively participate in Agile ceremonies throughout the entire lifecycle of assigned initiatives

judge.rationale: All required sections are present. It strongly emphasizes React and TypeScript, though some backend/architecture mentions slightly dilute the frontend focus.

The ideal candidate is a strong team player who thrives in challenging projects and can drive technical solutions from concept through to production deployment.
